title: CrossVersionMigrator pre-flight fails open against a codeless destination
description: A staticcall probe to a codeless address returns ok == true with short data, so _migratorOf and _isRegisteredOn each waive themselves; initiateMigration then freezes the source pool into the one-way Migrating state against a destination that does not exist.
impact: None on assets. Recoverable operational freeze: oldStaker.setMigrator re-points the migrator (demonstrated in the PoC) and userMigrate remains a permissionless self-exit throughout.
recommendation: Constructor code.length guard on the destination.
preservedFromMerge: The fail-open is deliberate and correctly documented for version-agnosticism.
`< 64` does NOT accidentally swallow the empty-registry case - an empty registry ABI-encodes to exactly 64 bytes and is honestly rejected.
distinctFrom: 7cdb92fdc7 (rootCauseClass irreversible-action-without-precondition-validation) - deliberately a different root-cause class so the two do not collide on one fingerprint.
